_comment: Listing catalog for nextaibreakout.com. The build reads this file for dated tip lists and homepage latest-N strips. Append new posts here; see CATALOG.md. Dates are real publish dates, never invented.

entries.title: Talk to one lead bot
entries.summary: I don't talk to my whole Grok Bot fleet. I talk to one lead bot, and it routes work to the specialists.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Quality Checker in front of you
entries.summary: Every bot's work goes through a Quality Checker bot before it reaches me. I don't want five versions of "done." I want one reviewed answer.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Agent-to-agent handoffs
entries.summary: Specialists don't report to me. They hand work to each other with a clear output, and the lead bot brings me one result.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Drafts only, then I approve
entries.summary: Bots draft; I approve sends, spending and anything that goes public. The one exception is my daily news post, which an automated checker clears first.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Save working workflows as skills
entries.summary: When a workflow works, I save it as a skill and share it across bots so they don't reinvent the steps. A skill is a reusable playbook, not a prompt I retype every morning.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Check the timezone on every routine
entries.summary: I had a routine on the wrong timezone. It quietly missed its slot, and I only noticed when the work didn't show up. Cron doesn't care what you meant. It cares what zone you set.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Watch usage, then pause routines
entries.summary: Usage ran out and every routine failed at once. Now I watch the meter and pause routines before they all crash. A fleet is only useful if it's still running tomorrow.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: We built Blabara in one day
entries.summary: On Oct 16, my brother and I built Blabara, an Android voice-dictation app, in one day with a team of Grok Bots. Not a slide deck. A real app, in a day.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: One group chat per project
entries.summary: When bots share a project, I put them in one group chat with clear roles. One channel, one job, then close it when the work is done.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: No fix without a before and after
entries.summary: No bug is fixed until it's proven with a before and after. A bot saying "done" isn't proof. Show me what it looked like, then show me what changed.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: One-tap approvals for spend and credentials
entries.summary: Spending and credentials stay on a one-tap approval. I don't auto-allow those. A bot can draft the step. I still press the button.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Bot drafts the email, a checker reviews it
entries.summary: I had a bot build a daily email, then a checker bot review it before anything could go out. Fast draft, slow send. That's the only way I'd let a routine touch an audience.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Script the cards, don't redesign every post
entries.summary: I don't design a new image for every post. A script builds the cards in one brand style: same colours, same type, no photos of people. Consistency beats a one-off graphic every time.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Daily news posts go out after a gate
entries.summary: Daily news posts write, pass an automated gate, and go out to the site and X on a schedule. Everything else still waits for my OK.
entries.source: First added in git commit 803137e on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Add /tips/ hub and 14 Grok Bot tip pages (preview only)". tips.py also uses 2026-11-12 as the sitemap lastmod and draft day.

entries.title: Give every bot one job
entries.summary: A bot asked to market, code, and file invoices gets mushy.
entries.source: First added in git commit a7fdbdf on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Tips preview: hub-only anchors, --accent variable, gold default", later the same morning as the 14 tip pages.

entries.title: Write the checker's rules down, and add one for every miss
entries.summary: I don't want the same mistake slipping through twice: a wrong sign-off, an invented figure, or an unproven "fixed."
entries.source: First added in git commit a7fdbdf on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Tips preview: hub-only anchors, --accent variable, gold default", later the same morning as the 14 tip pages.

entries.title: Keep one repo off-limits to the rest of the fleet
entries.summary: I don't want two bots pushing to the same app repo.
entries.source: First added in git commit a7fdbdf on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Tips preview: hub-only anchors, --accent variable, gold default", later the same morning as the 14 tip pages.

entries.title: Stay quiet unless something changed
entries.summary: A scheduled bot that wakes up just to say nothing changed is wasted work.
entries.source: First added in git commit a7fdbdf on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Tips preview: hub-only anchors, --accent variable, gold default", later the same morning as the 14 tip pages.

entries.title: Prefer a script over a model when the job is deterministic
entries.summary: I'd rather not pay for a model wake to diff a list, check a price, or filter an inbox when a script can do that job.
entries.source: First added in git commit a7fdbdf on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Tips preview: hub-only anchors, --accent variable, gold default", later the same morning as the 14 tip pages.

entries.title: Put a human publish gate in front of the website
entries.summary: Unreviewed auto content, including CJK text and unverified ranking blurbs, reached the NAB homepage and daily pages in early November 2026.
entries.source: First added in git commit a7fdbdf on 2026-11-12 (America/Halifax, UTC-4), "Tips preview: hub-only anchors, --accent variable, gold default", later the same morning as the 14 tip pages.

entries.title: AI didn't invent Android TV debloating, but one repo says it's now a 15-minute job
entries.summary: People are using Claude Code to disable bloat and home-screen ad rows on Android and Google TVs over ADB. What it does, what it doesn't, and how to do it safely.
entries.source: Blog front matter date: 2026-10-19. First published in git commit ace6dcc on 2026-10-19 (America/Edmonton, UTC-6), "Blog: publish 'Claude Code Android TV debloat' post".

entries.title: Open every post with a hook line
entries.summary: On Nov 14 I rewrote the first line of 7 X drafts: Days 10 to 14 and two weekly thread openers. A hook is a true, specific first line the post delivers.
entries.source: First published 2026-11-14 (America/Edmonton) on the tips-hooks branch.

entries.title: Turn lessons into posts
entries.summary: On Nov 14, the hook-line rule became a lesson post that goes through the same automated gate as my daily news.
entries.source: First published 2026-11-14 (America/Edmonton) on the tips-hooks branch.

entries.title: Re-check after late edits
entries.summary: On Nov 14, Day 12 and Day 14 copy was corrected after the first review, then went back to the checker. A pass only covers the version it reviewed.
entries.source: First published 2026-11-14 (America/Edmonton) on the tips-hooks branch.
